**Refuse.** The brief shows a bundled curve (bundle_share 1.0, completer_share 0.94, top3 at 0.86) with only 5 buyers on the curve, plus a launch bot present. That is a concentrated, operator-controlled launch pattern, not an organic one, despite the "ORGANIC" label. The 2-minute sell-to-buy ratio of 0.64 means insiders were already exiting. Last 15 minutes show 222 sellers against 290 buyers, with net flow of 66.58 SOL, but with heavy sell pressure on a 197 SOL pool. The 7.5% drawdown from the 30-minute high is shallow, and the desk has no basis to expect a recovery.

If the desk overrides and buys anyway, the floor is $5, stop at 20%, and a 15-minute hold, since a 30-second fill delay and 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs leave little room. But the default is a skip.
